name: Admin Starter
description: Build admin panels, dashboards, and internal tools with a compact sidebar, reusable components, forms, and data tables.
useWhen: An admin panel or internal tool needs navigation, forms, tables, and settings
A user asks to manage business records or operational workflows
avoidWhen: A marketing site, blog, storefront, or content-first site is the primary experience
The prompt requires a different framework or an existing repository
capabilities: Searchable and sortable demo collection with pagination
examplePrompt: Build an inventory admin with searchable products, stock alerts, and an edit-product form.
